notes.title: Version 4.0 is out
notes.content: Updated the menus and level select as well as fix some errors

notes.title: Version 3.0 is Here
notes.content:
Version 3.0 is here

Added more levels 
New level selection 

Added Atari VSC Modern controller support

the price has also been lowered to $3 USD

thank you everyone for there support

notes.title: Version 3 and New Price
notes.content: Hey everyone I am glad to announce  I am working on version 3.0 it will have new levels as well as I am changing the level section screen to a Hub world instead I have also lowered the price from $5 to $3 I hope you continue to enjoy Kuro Neko and hope you look forward to our new update coming soon.

notes.title: Linux/ Steam OS Version
notes.content: I have added a Linux/ Steam OS Version

notes.title: Version 3.0 out soon
notes.content:
Hey everyone I am happy to announce that version 3.0 will be out soon.

It will have new levels, Linux support  as well as Atari VCS Controller support.

Will post an game update as soon as  its available

notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content:
I am pleased to announce that version 2.0 is now out on Steam.

I have added new levels and a new Battle Mode level for you to enjoy.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39079998/ea2b74b28eee535c69360f59470b4b0b08075db5.png[/img]


If you have been looking to get Kuro Neko it goes on Sale tomorrow May 8th.

We look forward to all your comments and suggestions on what to add in the next update.

notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content: I would like to thank everyone for buying Kuro Neko and I am happy to announce Version 2.0 will be out soon, It will have more single player levels and more Battle Mode levels

notes.title: Release Date
notes.content: We are happy to announce that we are planning on releasing Kuro Neko on March 15th give or take a few days for steams approval.

notes.title: Update February 10th
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that our lockdown should be ending in the next month or so once it ends we will be in the office to put the finishing touches on Kuro Neko

We are sorry for any inconvenience this delay has caused

notes.title: Game Delay
notes.content:
Hey everyone due to the current world state we have to delay our game by a little bit.

As a thank you to everyone that put it on there wishlist and were hoping it would release tomorrow we are sorry for the delay and will be releasing a free update a little after the games releases.


Thanks for you support
Nicholas Van Dyk
Lead Game Designer
